verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
verses.english: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.english: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
